title: : F AITH IS NOW!
verse: “. without faith it is impossible to please God.”
body: : F AITH IS NOW! “. without faith it is impossible to please God.” (NIV) Heb 11:6 It takes faith to please - satisfy and thrill - Him! Without faith, pleasing God is a mere illusory - completely impractical and out of reality. Faith matters when what matters matter most. “. the just shall live by his faith.” is repeated four times in the Bible [Hab 2:4, Rom 1:17, Gal 3;11 and Heb 10:38]. Could this ever be by coincidence? No, not at all! It’s to show the necessity of faith. The Bible went ahead to say he who desires to walk with Him must first and foremost believe in the reality of His existence. See what the Bible says about God in Isaiah 40:28, God is everlasting - His reign is without end. He is the Omniscient who knows all things inside out. Besides this knowledge, you have to know that He’s a faithful Rewarder of them that diligently seek Him by faith.
confession: I believe in the reality of God’s eternal existence. God is real and His supremacy is above all. He is the supernatural being whose origin is dateless - He is total and absolute. His reign is without foreign influence - He’s all in all and He’s above all. I believe in His incorruptibility and indestructibility. I will forever trust Him.

title: : F AITH MA TTERS
body: : F AITH MA TTERS “So faith comes by hearing [what is told], and what is heard comes by the preaching [of the message that came from the lips] of Christ (the Messiah Himself)” (AMP) Rom 10:17 The Bible went straight to declare, “so faith comes.” Faith is a major key to success. So, everyone - the young and the old - has a spiritual responsibility to keep the faith alive and alert. No matter how small that faith looks, never loose it through carelessness and insensitivity. Use your faith! It grows by use. Anything you don’t use; you loose! Faith grows by what you hear - what you hear will either produce faith or fear in you. You are exactly what you hear and who you listen to! Experiencing growth in your faith life warrants that you listen to faith building words - teachings - again and again until your whole being is faithchemicalised. This produces resultant effects that strengthen you for a great life, Ps 18:30. As you grow in faith, you enjoy more of God.
prayer: Holy Spirit, thank You for revealing Your Mind to me. Thank You for the understanding of Your Word. I ask for Your strengthening power within to consciously engage in faith-building process in Jesus precious name, Amen.

title: GO, GROW YOUR F AITH
verse: “. but the just shall live by his faith” (KJV) Hab 2:4
body: GO, GROW YOUR F AITH “. but the just shall live by his faith” (KJV) Hab 2:4 John 3:36 says, “He that believeth on the Son hath everlasting life: and he that believeth not the Son shall not see life.” (KJV). This is mind-boggling and overwhelming! He that believes [from the Greek pisteou meaning entrusts one's spiritual well-being to Christ] has everlasting - perpetual, neverending, undying - life. What a revelation! Belief brings you to the realm of bliss. Everything around, within and without you experience real bliss with real belief. He that believes has life. He that has faith has a future. The life a faithman has is a Godkind of life - the absolute fullness of zoe. He that believes not has not seen life let alone having it. What a waste of life! Every thing is yours by faith. You may not enjoy them all at your own desired time but you’ll enjoy them all at His own appointed time. With your faith kept alive and your dream kept vivacious, a fulfilling future awaits you.
confession: I won’t give up on my dream - I will hold on till I’m paid up. I choose never to stop trusting Him. By His limitless help, I will surely prosper beyond my widest dream.

title: : NO F AITH, NO FUTURE
body: : NO F AITH, NO FUTURE “. Increase our faith” (KJV) Luke 17:5 If there is any highest prayer focus every believer must place a demand on, it’s a prayer of “Lord, increase [my] faith.” You know what, with increasing faith you experience increasing favour. Apostles of old felt the need for extraordinary degree of faith to do extraordinary degree of exploits. They desired more faith in the face of overwhelming trials. Do you desire to experience the fullness of life? Then go for the fullness of faith. Ask Him over and over again to increase your faith - never depend on your own wisdom. Seek His divine help! Daily look unto Him as the Author and Finisher of your faith. “Keep your eyes on Jesus, who both began and finished this race we're in. Study how he did it. Because he never lost sight of where he was headed - that exhilarating finish in and with God - he could put up with anything along the way: cross, shame, whatever. And now he's there, in the place of honor, right alongside God” (TBCL). PRA YER: Father, in the name of Jesus, I ask that You increase - add, boost, and multiply - my faith in You. Take me beyond this level to higher dimension of faith in Jesus precious name, Amen.

title: : LORD, INCREASE MY FAITH
body: : LORD, INCREASE MY FAITH “For we walk by faith [we regulate our lives and conduct ourselves.” (AMP) 2 Cor 5:7 Two little girls were counting their pennies. One said, "I have five pennies." The other said, "I have ten." "No," said the first little girl, "You have just five cents, the same as I." "But," the second child quickly replied, "my father said when he comes home tonight he would give me five cents, and so I have ten cents." Trustingly, she counted what her father had promised. That's exactly how a Christian should live - counting on the promises of God. His promises are of highest value back up by His integrity. His promises are your tickets to participating and partaking in His goodness. Walking and living by faith entails losing the sight of the natural for the supernatural. In sickness, declare, “Surely he hath borne [my] griefs, and carried [my] sorrows.” (KJV) Isa 53:4-5. In times of challenges, say, “The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want. He maketh me to lie down in green pastures: he leadeth me beside the still waters. (KJV) Ps 23:1-6.
confession: I’m not moved by what I see. I’m not moved by what I hear. I’m not moved by what I feel. I’m only moved by the Word of God.

title: : W ALKING AND LIVING BY FAITH
verse: those who followed, "Assuredly, I say to you, I
body: : W ALKING AND LIVING BY FAITH “When Jesus heard it, He marveled, and said to those who followed, "Assuredly, I say to you, I have not found such great faith, not even in Israel!” (NKJV) Mat 8:10 Today, we’ll be having a close look at the faith account of the Centurion - a Roman military officer. This man was a heathen - Mt 8:10 - but with his living faith and great humility, his expectation could not be denied. The first degree of humility is to acknowledge the need for His mercies. This, coupled with great faith, great life would not be denied. “And when Jesus was entered into Capernaum, there came unto him a centurion, beseeching him, And saying, Lord. speak the word only, and my servant shall be healed ” Matt 8: 5-10. His faith was so strong that he only needed Jesus to speak forth - believing that his servant shall be made whole. How the Centurion believed the Bible, Ps 33:9. With your continuos great faith you benefit from His continuos great acts.
confession: I step out of the realm of common faith to the realms of uncommon faith. I have strength for all things in Christ Who empowers me. I am equal to anything through Him Who infuses inner strength into me; I am self-sufficient in Christ.

title: : GREA T FAITH, GREA T LIFE
body: : GREA T FAITH, GREA T LIFE “He staggered not at the promise of God. but was strong in faith.” (KJV) Rom 4:20 Something is so unique about the life of Abraham. He was truly a man of faith - his faith was unwavering [steady and firm], unfaltering [strong and resolute] and unswerving [staunch and constant] even in the midst of uncertainty - how he demonstrated the steadfastness of faith. TBCL says, “He didn't tiptoe around God's promise asking cautiously skeptical questions. He plunged into the promise and came up strong, ready for God.” Abraham never doubted the Divinity. TLB says, “But Abraham never doubted. He believed God.” He made a personal choice not to doubt amidst doubtful circumstances. He did not let his advanced age and that of his wife, prevent him from believing the promise. On no account do you agree with the devil to doubt God’s Word. Here is the unpleasant side of doubt, Rom 14:23. Doubt damns - It damns destiny and drag the dream into the mire. I leave you with Luke 1:45.
confession: I will not waver through unbelief. But rather be strengthened in faith giving glory to God - every day. I will never doubt the Divinity but rather doubt my doubt in the face of difficulty.

title: : DOUBT YOUR DOUBT; NEVER DOUBT THE DIVINITY
verse: priests were obedient to the faith” (KJV) Acts 6:7
body: : DOUBT YOUR DOUBT; NEVER DOUBT THE DIVINITY “. and the number of the disciples multiplied in Jerusalem greatly; and a great company of the priests were obedient to the faith” (KJV) Acts 6:7 Acts 19:20 says, “Thus mightily did the Lord's Message spread and triumph!” (WNT). YLT says, “So powerfully was the word of God increasing and prevailing.” This speaks of the increase and prevalence of the Word. The gospel so greatly multiplied that it became more mighty and extensive in its influence that a great company of men were subject to the faith. Acts 10:42. He commands us to preach [from Greek word - kerusso meaning to herald and proclaim as a public crier of divine truth]. This is our most noble assignment on earth. And this is what we must all strategically position ourselves to do as individuals, families, groups, organizations and churches. The gospel of our Lord must be published time and again among all in our offices, market squares, cinema houses, garages, villages, cities and wherever people are found. Matt 28:19-20.
prayer: Father, I’m sorry for my past negligence. I promise never to slack in this noble assignment. I’ll preach the Word in Jesus precious name, Amen.

title: : LEADING MEN TO FAITH AND F AITHFULNESS
body: : LEADING MEN TO FAITH AND F AITHFULNESS “And unto one he gave five talents, to another two, and to another one; to every man according to his several ability. ” (KJV) Mt 25:15 “For the kingdom of heaven is as a man travelling into a far country, who called his own servants, and delivered unto them his goods.” (KJV) Matt 25:14-18. With different proportion of gifts and talents given to each individual, the same level of fidelity was required, and equal reward was given to them, Read 1 Cor 12:7, 29, 30. “And so he that had received five talents. His lord said unto him, Well done, thou good and faithful servant. I will make thee ruler over many things. He also that had received two talents. His lord said unto him, Well done, good and faithful servant. I will make thee ruler over many things. Then he which had received the one talent. His lord answered and said unto him, Thou wicked and slothful servant. I should have received mine own with usury And thus there is perfect equity” (KJV) Matt 25: 20-27. God’s gifts and graces are not for nothing - they are for kingdom profiting. Read Rom 12:6-8.
prayer: Dear Lord God, I ask that You help me to be a true kingdom servant serving from the heart and doing all to Your glory in Jesus’ name, Amen.

title: : F AITH, FIDELITY AND MANIFEST ATION OF THE SPIRIT
body: : F AITH, FIDELITY AND MANIFEST ATION OF THE SPIRIT “And he said to them, Why are you full of fear, O you of little faith? Then he got up and gave orders to the winds and the sea; and there was a great calm” (BBE) Mat 8:26 Fear is nothing but F-alse E-xperience A-ppearing R-eal. You can’t be fearing and be daring - where faith falters, fear flourishes. It takes faith to be audacious and valiant. You can talk to that barrenness, lack, infirmity and demonic attack with that grain-like mustard seed faith. “He said to them. if you have faith [that is living] like a grain of mustard seed, you can say to this mountain, Move from here to yonder place, and it will move; and nothing will be impossible to you” (Amp) Matt 17:20. Here is a prophetic Word for you, “Fear thou not; for I am with thee: be not dismayed; for I am thy God: I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee; yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness. Behold, all they that were incensed against thee shall be ashamed and confounded: they shall be as nothing; and they that strive with thee shall perish.” (KJV) Is 54:10-13.
confession: I talk to every wind - mention them - I command [you] to bow. I prophesy my supernatural turn around in the name of Jesus.

title: 1: STOP BEEN FEARFUL, TALK TO THE WIND
verse: shall not doubt. shall have whatsoever he saith”
body: 1: STOP BEEN FEARFUL, TALK TO THE WIND “. whosoever shall say unto this mountain. and shall not doubt. shall have whatsoever he saith” (KJV) Mark 11:23 Mountains don’t move on their own accord. They move in response to your faith-declaration. Your mouth plays a major role in molding your life. With your mouth, you mount pressure on the devil, the devourer. “Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour” (KJV) 1 Pet 5:8. The journey into your miracle begins with a simple confession back up with a wholehearted believing. The end result is what follows - thou shalt be saved. The word saved is from Greek word sozo meaning delivered, protected, preserved, be well and be made whole. With your confession and believing, you enjoy divine deliverance, protection, preservation, wellness and wholeness. “So you will be saved, if you honestly say, "Jesus is Lord," and if you believe with all your heart that God raised him from death.” (CEV) Rom 10:9-11.
confession: Satan is no mate. Under my feet satan shall dwell. Forever he shall never rise. I am placed far above principalities and forces of darkness.

title: : YOUR MOUTH MA TTERS IN MOVING YOUR MOUNT AIN
verse: through, they let down the bed.” (NKJV) Mark 2:4
body: : YOUR MOUTH MA TTERS IN MOVING YOUR MOUNT AIN “And when they could not come near. they uncovered the roof. So when they had broken through, they let down the bed.” (NKJV) Mark 2:4 James 2:26 says, “For as the body without the spirit is dead, so faith without works is dead also” (KJV). Taking bold steps of obedience with your faith is the answer to your miracle, “For as the human body apart from the spirit is lifeless, so faith apart from [its] works of obedience is also dead.” TBCL says, “The very moment you separate body and spirit, you end up with a corpse. Separate faith and works and you get the same thing: a corpse.” You need a living working faith to take part in a living worthy future - without it life becomes a mere existence, so boring. How great was the faith of those noble men who brought the paralytic man to Jesus for healing - they couldn’t just be stopped. Jesus saw nothing but their faith and their dreamed miracle could not be denied in the face of work and dogged determination.
prayer: Father, I ask that Your Holy Spirit be my guide in every step and action taken towards my desired dream. Guide me daily to be taking heaven-ordained steps. And prevent me from being manipulated in the name of Jesus, Amen.

title: : YOUR MIRACLE IS NOT ONLY IN YOUR F AITH
verse: "But I have prayed for you, that your faith should
body: : YOUR MIRACLE IS NOT ONLY IN YOUR F AITH "But I have prayed for you, that your faith should not fail; and when you have returned to Me, strengthen your brethren” (NKJV) Luke 22:32 The power of real, true praise cannot be overelaborated. Real, true praise carries real true power. “Let the saints be joyful in glory: let them sing aloud upon their beds. Let the high praises of God be in their mouth, and a twoedged sword in their hand; To execute vengeance upon the heathen, and punishments upon the people; To bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron; To execute upon them the judgment written: this honour have all his saints.” (KJV) Ps 149:5-9. Keep God’s praises in your heart and mouth. It’s a two-edged sword. It does wonders of executing vengeance. It brings about God’s judgment on the enemies. It binds the kings and nobles with chains and fetters of iron and fast tracks God’s written judgment. These are the powers resident in real, true, heartfelt praise, Acts 16:25-26. With a real true midnight worship and warfare, you enjoy a real true midnight wonders.
prayer: Dear Lord God, I am ready to engage myself in real true midnight worship and warfare, so as to enjoy real divine help. So help me Lord!

title: : F AITH AND REAL, TRUE PRAISE
body: : F AITH AND REAL, TRUE PRAISE “Jesus answered and said unto them, Verily I say unto you, If ye have faith, and doubt not, ye shall not only do this which is done to the fig tree, but also if ye shall say unto this mountain, Be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea; it shall be done” (KJV) Matt 21:21 That’s faith tenacity and doggedness - having faith and doubting not. That’s what it takes to breakthrough. It’s the faith that will not quit in the face of adversity - so resolute, so rugged, so focused on God. It makes all the difference between those who enjoy it all and those who endure it all. Faith is a kingdom lifestyle - a must practice. The three Hebrew men practiced faith tenacity and doggedness [Dan 3:13-27]. The woman with the issue of blood demonstrated it [Matt 9:21-22]. Blind Bartimaeus manifested it [Lk18:35-42]. The Syrophoenician woman displayed it [Mk 7:25-30]. The crippled at Lystra exhibited it [Acts 19:9-10]. And none was denied.
confession: I step up higher in faith tenacity and doggedness. I [mention your name] become so steadfast, so unwavering and so single minded in my faith-life. I receive the abundance of Your grace to be strong in the faith.

title: : F AITH TENACITY AND DOGGEDNESS
body: : F AITH TENACITY AND DOGGEDNESS “By faith. when he was called. obeyed. not knowing whither he went” (KJV) Heb 11:8 It was said of old, "Faith and reason may be compared to two travelers: Faith is like a man in full health who can walk twenty or thirty miles at a time without suffering. Reason is like a child, who can only with difficulty accomplish three or four miles. On a given day Reason says to Faith, 'O good Faith, let me walk with thee.' Faith replies, 'O Reason, thou canst never walk with me!' However, to try their paces, they set out together, but they soon find it hard to keep company. When they come to a deep river, Reason says, 'I can never ford this,' but Faith wades through it singing. No one can figure it out perfectly by reasoning. “Now the LORD had said unto Abram, Get thee out of thy country. unto a land that I will shew thee.” (KJV) Gen12: 1-2. If Abram had reasoned it out, he would have missed it. He never knew it all, yet he followed it all. His old age wasn’t a barrier, he departed as the Lord had spoken.
confession: I put my trust in God. My life shall be governed by His Word, living by faith and not by fact. I will not lean on my own understanding. In all my ways I will acknowledge Him.

title: : F AITH-BASED OR F ACT-BASED
body: : F AITH-BASED OR F ACT-BASED “And beside this, giving all diligence, add to your faith virtue.” (KJV) 2 Pet 1:5 As good as faith is, you’ve to add virtue. Moral excellence, that’s virtue defined. Add it to your faith. “So don't lose a minute in building on what you've been given, complementing your basic faith with good character, spiritual understanding” (TBCL). Life is made complete with good character. “Finally, brethren, whatsoever things are true, whatsoever things are honest, whatsoever things are just, whatsoever things are pure, whatsoever things are lovely, whatsoever things are of good report; if there be any virtue, and if there be any praise, think on these things”(KJV) Phil 4:8. Apostle Paul recommends all round righteousness - having the mind that was in Christ and to walk as He himself also walked. We are to attend to every thing by which we might bring honour to God, good to our fellow creatures, and credit to ourselves.
prayer: Thank You dear Jesus for Your Word. I place a demand on Your grace to live just as the Word commands and not as the world dictates. I fix my thoughts on what is good and godly in Jesus precious name I pray, Amen.

title: : ADD VIR TUE TO YOUR F AITH
verse: touched the hem of his garment” (KJV) Matt 9:20
body: : ADD VIR TUE TO YOUR F AITH “. a woman, which was diseased with an issue of blood twelve years, came behind him, and touched the hem of his garment” (KJV) Matt 9:20 “For she said within herself, If I may but touch his garment, I shall be whole. But Jesus turned him about. be of good comfort; thy faith hath made thee whole. And the woman was made whole from that hour” (KJV) Matt 9: 21-22. According to the Jewish law, she was reckoned unclean by the disease of the issue of blood “And if a woman have an issue of her blood many days. she shall be unclean” (KJV) Lev 15:25. The woman couldn’t make personal request to Jesus neither could she touch His person. She had expended all, and grew worse, Mk 5:26. She took a step of faith towards Jesus. A step of faith towards Jesus is a step of mercy. She touched and was transformed. Virtue flowed not by the reason of her finger but by the reason of her faith. She came trembling, but she went triumphing. Faith is the drawer with which you draw from the well of mercy.
confession: I am free! Free from anguish and agony, sorrow and sadness, trouble and torment. I am free from all afflictions faith. Hallelujah!

title: : TOUCH AND TRANSFORMA TION OF F AITH
body: : TOUCH AND TRANSFORMA TION OF F AITH “For whatsoever is born of God overcometh the world: and this is the victory that overcometh the world, even our faith” (KJV) 1 John 5:4 It’s been said, “Ye are of God, little children, and have overcome them: because greater is he that is in you, than he that is in the world” (KJV) 1 John 4:4. You are under the influence of Spirit divine - You originated from Him. You are not of this world, your citizen is in heaven. “Every God-begotten person conquers the world's ways. The power that brings the world to its knees is our faith” (TBCL). You’ve conquered. Never to be dominated by demons. You’re not in the class of the loser. You’re a plus and not a minus! You’re a prevailer by divine ordination, 1Pet 2:9. This is the mystery of our faith, go forth, show forth the praises of Him who hath called you out of darkness into His marvellous light.
confession: I confess what the Bible says about me: My origin is from heaven. I’m not of this world. I am a victorious being - never a defeated person. I am more than a conqueror through Him who strengthens me. I’m not in the class of the loser. I’m a plus factor. A prevailer by divine ordination. Say this repeatedly. [Hymn: Jesus Loves Even Me]

title: : THE MYSTER Y OF F AITH
verse: was once delivered unto the saints” (KJV) Jude 3
body: : THE MYSTER Y OF F AITH “. ye should earnestly contend for the faith which was once delivered unto the saints” (KJV) Jude 3 1 Tim 1:13-14 says, “Hold fast the form of sound words, which thou hast heard of me, in faith and love which is in Christ Jesus. That good thing which was committed unto thee keep by the Holy Ghost which dwelleth in us” (KJV). To say that this is the end of time is an underestimation. The very end of the end is right with us, 2 Tim 3:1-4. For this purpose, we are commanded to hold fast the form of sound words. Deviation from the Word is detrimental. Be a non-compromiser. Stand for righteous living at home, work and every where you find yourself. Be a standard of Christianity. “Fight the good fight of faith, lay hold on eternal life, whereunto thou art also called, and hast professed a good profession before many witnesses” (KJV) 1 Tim 6:12. Be a faith defender! A faith contender! Defend, contend and keep the sound Word of God. Let others see Jesus [ the Saviour, the Purifier, the baptizer, the Healer, the Prosperer, the soon coming King.] in you.
confession: And I’ll always keep to the standard of the Word. In all my ways, I will stand for righteous living. Through me others will experience Jesus.

title: : CONTEND FOR THE F AITH
body: : CONTEND FOR THE F AITH “Who through faith subdued kingdoms, wrought righteousness, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions” (KJV) Heb 11:33 1 Sam 17:34-36 says, “And David said unto Saul, Thy servant kept his father's sheep, and there came a lion, and a bear, and took a lamb out of the flock: And I went out after him, and smote him, and delivered it out of his mouth. and this uncircumcised Philistine shall be as one of them.” (KJV). How audacious! David was a young man - so bold, so fearless. “And what shall I more say? for the time would fail me to tell of Gedeon, and of Barak, and of Samson, and of Jephthae; of David also, and Samuel, and of the prophets: Who through faith subdued kingdoms. (KJV) Heb 11:32-34. You see, you don’t function in the realm you don't have faith for. Your level of faith determines your level of kingdom performance. Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthae, David, Samuel and the prophets were all men of faith. You can do what they did!
prayer: Almighty God, having gone through the account of those who did exploits, I pray for the Spirit enablement, to passionately pursuit eternal cause in the precious name of Jesus, Amen.

title: : EXPLOITS OF F AITH
body: : EXPLOITS OF F AITH “. and they chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Ghost.” (KJV) Acts 6:5 He was a man of deep spirituality. Stephen possessed seven-fold fullness of the Holy Spirit: 1. He was a man of honest report - Acts 6:3. 2. He was a man full of and controlled by the Holy Spirit - Acts 6:5, “. Stephen, a man. full of and controlled by the Holy Spirit.” (Amp). 3. He was a man of faith and power - Acts 6:8, “Stephen, brimming with God's grace and energy, was doing wonderful things.”( TBCL). 4. He possessed irresistible wisdom and intelligence - Acts 6:10, “But they were not able to resist the intelligence and the wisdom.” (AMP). 5. He had an angelic-look blazing with light - Acts 6:15, “And all who were sitting in the Sanhedrin looked intently at him and saw that his face was like the face of an angel” (HCSB). 6. He was a man of vision and revelation - Acts 7:56, “And said, Behold, I see the heavens opened, and the Son of man standing on the right hand of God” (KJV). 7. He was a man of love - Acts 7:60, “He knelt down and cried out in a loud voice, "Lord! Do not remember this sin against them!” (TEV). A man who possessed it all!
prayer: Spend time to pray for all the qualities.

title: : MEN OF F AITH 1
body: : MEN OF F AITH 1 “. the saying pleased the whole multitude: and they chose Philip.” (KJV) Act 6:5 Philip was one of the seven men chosen to minister to the neglected Greek-speaking widows in the church at Jerusalem, Acts 6:1-6. Philip’s extraordinary exploits were remarkable and outstanding - he turned the city of Samaria upside down for Jesus. See how it went in Acts 8:5-8, “Then Philip went down to the city of Samaria, and preached Christ unto them. unclean spirits, crying with loud voice, came out of many that were possessed with them: and many taken with palsies, and that were lame, were healed. And there was great joy in that city” (KJV). You can cause great joy in the lives of many! Begin right where you are. Carry out personal evangelism, and morning cry. Give out tracts and devotionals. Disciple them for Christ. Other exploits of Philip the evangelist are these: he was a man of the Spirit, preached to the Ethiopian eunuch, Act 8:27-38; caught away by the Spirit to Azotus, Act 8:39-40 and had his family under control, Acts 21:9.
confession: I can do what Philip - I am spreading the gospel light, walking in the miraculous and causing great joy for many.

title: : MEN OF F AITH 2
body: : MEN OF F AITH 2 “Therefore being justified by faith, we have peace with God.” (KJV) Romans 5:1 Amplified Version of our text reads, “Therefore, since we are justified (acquitted, declared righteous, and given a right standing with God) through faith, let us [grasp the fact that we] have [the peace of reconciliation to hold and to enjoy] peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ (the Messiah, the Anointed One).” In a legal sense, justification connotes being just or guiltless. In biblical perspective, the Greek, dikaioo, means declared free and innocent. You’re justified - when you wholeheartedly confess your sin and ask for His forgiveness - just-as-if-you-had-neversinned. When God forgives, He puts your sin behind Him and deals with you as acquitted. This is mind-blowing! After been justified, here is God’s express expectation, “For the grace of God that bringeth salvation hath appeared to all men, Teaching us that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts.” (KJV) Titus 2:11-13.
confession: I believe what the Bible says about me. I am justified - acquitted, declared righteous, and given a right standing with God through faith. No more guilt! No more condemnation!

title: : JUSTIFIED BY FAITH
verse: purifying their hearts by faith” (KJV) Acts 15:9
body: : JUSTIFIED BY FAITH “And put no difference between us and them, purifying their hearts by faith” (KJV) Acts 15:9 Heb 9:13-14 declares, “For if the blood of bulls and of goats, and the ashes of an heifer sprinkling the unclean, sanctifieth to the purifying of the flesh: How much more shall the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without spot to God, purge your conscience from dead works to serve the living God?” (KJV). We’re purified not by works but by faith. He wants your conscience purged from dead works so as to serve the living Him without fear and in righteousness, “That he would grant unto us, that we being delivered out of the hand of our enemies might serve him without fear, In holiness and righteousness before him, all the days of our life” (KJV) Luke 1:74-75. Read 1 Peter 1:22.
prayer: Lord Jesus, thank You for redeeming my soul from destruction. Thank You for making me Your dear son/daughter. By the power unlimited through Your blood, I ask for my total cleansing. Make me pure so as to serve You with clean and clear conscience all the days of my life in the name of Jesus, Amen.

title: : PURIFIED BY FAITH
body: : PURIFIED BY FAITH “Confirming the souls of the disciples, and exhorting them to continue in the faith, and that we must through much tribulation enter into the kingdom of God” (KJV) Acts 14:22 A song writer wrote, “I have decided to follow Jesus, I have decided to follow Jesus, I have decided to follow Jesus, No turning back, No turning back.” The kingdom race is an individual race. Parents can’t run it for children neither can children run the same for parents. Spouse can’t run it for spouse. It’s personal! And based on our text, we’ve to expect persecution and tribulation. And be so determined not to be separated from the love of Christ. Paul wrote in Rom 8:35-39, “Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? Shall tribulation, or distress, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword. For I am persuaded that neither death nor life, nor angels nor principalities nor powers, nor things present nor things to come, nor height nor depth, nor any other created thing, shall be able to.” (KJV) 2 Tim 2:11-12.
prayer: Father, I ask for Your guidance in every step of the way. Let Your Spirit keep my spirit strong in moments of trials in Jesus’ name, Amen.

title: : CONTINUING IN THE F AITH
body: : CONTINUING IN THE F AITH “Ask. seek. knock.” (KJV) Mat 7:7 Matt 7:7 is so powerful. Its right spiritual appropriation and application can grant you all that you will ever desire from God. “Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you: For every one that asketh receiveth; and he that seeketh findeth; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened. If ye then, being evil, know how to give good gifts unto your children, how much more shall your Father which is in heaven give good things to them that ask him?” Your business is in the asking, seeking and knocking while He does the rest. Amplified puts it thus, “Keep on asking and it will be given you; keep on seeking and you will find; keep on knocking [reverently] and [the door] will be opened to you.” The ABC of faith is in asking, believing and confessing. If you can ask for it according to His divine will, believing and confessing the same - without doubting - you’ll have what you desire, John 16:23-24.
prayer: My God, thank You for You’re a prayer answering God. Pour upon me the spirit of prayers and supplications. Cause me to wax strong in You in Jesus’ name, Amen.

title: : ABC OF F AITH
body: : ABC OF F AITH “. what seest thou? And I said, I see a rod of an almond tree. Then said the LORD unto me, Thou hast well seen: for I will hasten my word to perform it” (KJV) Jer 1:11-12 If you can’t see it, you can’t seize it - that’s the rule - you’ve got to see it so strong in your spirit man for you to seize it in reality. The Amplified of our text goes thus, “. what do you see? And I said, I see a branch or shoot of an almond tree [the emblem of alertness and activity, blossoming in late winter]. Then said the Lord to me, You have seen well, for I am alert and active, watching over My word to perform it.” God is the Performer of His glorious Word. He will not fail. Imagine and see a healthy life, a life free from sickness and disease. See how your spirit, soul and body are in perfect harmony. Let it sink into your sub-conscious mind. Don’t forget, what you see is what comes your way. The same is applicable in all areas.
confession: Behold I see a world of perfect peace and tranquility within and around me. I see myself grow from strength to strength. I see abundance and prosperity. I see marital bliss - a home of endless understanding. I see everything turn around for my good. I see God at work! MARCH 28: WHA T YOU SEE IS WHA T YOU SEIZE “And God wrought special miracles by the hands of Paul” (KJV) Acts 19:11 “So that from his body were brought unto the sick handkerchiefs or aprons, and the diseases departed from them, and the evil spirits went out of them” (KJV) Acts 19:12. You can walk in the supernatural like Paul through whom God wrought special miracles. “And these signs will follow those who believe: In My name they will cast out demons; they will speak with new tongues; they will take up serpents; and if they drink anything deadly, it will by no means hurt them; they will lay hands on the sick, and they will recover” (KJV) Mark 16:17-18. The secret is in the believing. By His name, you can cast out the devils. You can lay your hand on the sick for recovery. Yes, you can! You see, many years back, I never knew I could raise the dead child back to life until I took my place. If you’re a child of God, you can demonstrate God’s power wherever you find yourself, Matt 10:1.

title: : KEEP THANKING HIM WHILE W AITING
body: : KEEP THANKING HIM WHILE W AITING “Don't worry. in all your prayers ask God for what you need, always asking him with a thankful heart” (GNT) Phili 4:6 Every thanksliving is rooted in thanksgiving. Advance thanksgiving guarantees advance thanksliving. Advance praise guarantees advance prominence. “I will praise thee, O LORD, with my whole heart.” (KJV) Ps 9:1-2. Praise changes situations. Praise makes things happen. Praise affects you, affects the devil and affects God. Your faith is not complete without praise. “Keep your roots deep in him, build your lives on him, and become stronger in your faith, as you were taught. And be filled with thanksgiving” (TEV) Col 2:7. Keep a gaze high up! Keep thanking Him while waiting for your full package. Thank Him for who He is. Thank Him for His promises that are yea and amen. Never compare! Never covet! Never be in a haste! At His own time, He will make it beautiful, Ps 121:1-2.
confession: I’ll keep trusting Him till my divine appointed time comes. I will keep thanking Him till He makes it all beautiful. I will rejoice ever more. No need to worry. He is on my side. He is working things out for my good.
